xiaozhi_create.tooltip: Use the default client and automatically service events and startup retries in loop. No object name is needed.

xiaozhi_begin_official.tooltip: Wait for WiFi, obtain activation or start; retry activation/startup failures every 30 seconds.

xiaozhi_begin_websocket.message0: Xiaozhi connect WebSocket %1 token %2 root CA PEM %3 protocol %4
xiaozhi_begin_websocket.tooltip: wss:// requires a root CA; synchronizes time automatically. Replaces official startup for custom services.

xiaozhi_features.tooltip: Configure before startup; raw JSON retention uses additional memory.

xiaozhi_identity.message0: Xiaozhi custom device ID %1 client ID %2
xiaozhi_identity.tooltip: Custom WebSocket only; blank values use MAC and persistent UUID. Official provisioning manages its own identity.

xiaozhi_stop.tooltip: Cancel startup retries and finish shutdown in a subsequent loop. Wait until running is false before reconfiguration.

xiaozhi_audio_preset.message0: Xiaozhi audio board %1 enable local wake word %2
xiaozhi_audio_preset.tooltip: Use one audio configuration before startup. Wake installs the bundled Ni Hao Xiaozhi model into a dedicated model partition and requires PSRAM. OJoy includes calibrated audio settings. Audio only; no display initialization.
